author: Hacken
description: Detector monitors and procesess feeds via scripts pipeline

faq.name: How does it work
faq.value:
Detects new messages/events from a feed and uses message data as input to scripts pipeline.

Script results are used to generate alerts. Result can be treated as a score with a final `condition`.

faq.name: Cron
faq.value: Cron interval to check for new messages/events. Refer to [Cron](https://docs.extractor.live/common-configurations#cron) for more details

faq.name: Feeds
faq.value:
Feeds URI

Mulitple URI's can be specified with comma separation. If `type` is not specified, feed can be prefixed with type (`rss://`. `reddit://`, `twitter://@channel`)

faq.name: Max
faq.value: Max number of entries per Feed to process

faq.name: Category
faq.value: Message Category filter (comma separated list of categories). If not specified, all messages will be processed.

faq.name: Scripts
faq.value:
Scripts to execute

Scripts are executed in the order they are specified. Refer to [Scripts](https://docs.extractor.live/common-configurations#condition-threshold) for more details.

Scripts execution result will be in `result` meta field.

faq.name: Score
faq.value: Condition to filter Alerts score on `result` (result must be in the range: [0..1]). Refer to [Condition](https://docs.extractor.live/common-configurations#condition) for more details

faq.name: Description
faq.value: Description template for the Alert description. Can use any meta field as placeholder (e.g. `{result}`)

faq.name: Track Error
faq.value:
Track Errors

Muliple tags can be specified comma-separated (e.g. `sanctions, exploit`)

Negative condition can be specified by prefixing tag with exclamation mark (e.g. `! sanctions`)

__Tags__:

`cybercrime` - OFAC or othe cybercrime activity

`sanctions` - OFAC or other sanctioned entites

`sanctions_exposure` - Indirect exposure to sanctioned entities

`suspicious` - Suspcious activity

`exploit` - Activity in Exploit case

faq.name: Track Error Always
faq.value:
Track Errors Always

If enabled, the detector will track errors even if the script result is not a score.

faq.name: Severity
faq.value: Severity of the Alert. If not specified, the detector will use the severity of the script result.
